seo.title: Holiday cottage in Cour-Cheverny – La Vigneronne near Chambord, Beauval Zoo, the Loire Valley castles
seo.description: Stay at La Vigneronne, a characterful holiday home for 8 guests in Cour-Cheverny, near Cheverny, Chambord, Blois and Beauval Zoo.

hero.mainImageAlt: The façade and garden of La Maison Vigneronne
hero.note: A 10-minute walk from Château de Cheverny
hero.title: A characterful home between castles and nature in the Loir-et-Cher
hero.introduction: A bright and spacious 19th-century house where families and friends can gather in the heart of the Loire Valley castles and vineyards.

story.verticalNote: The house · the garden · the vineyards
story.title: Space to gather, room to breathe.
paragraphs: La Maison Vigneronne welcomes up to eight guests in a peaceful village setting. Its generous living spaces were designed for shared meals, long conversations and unhurried evenings.
Outside, the enclosed garden and courtyard offer children, readers and pétanque players their own favourite corner.

territory.largeImageCaption: The courtyard in the morning, the garden in the evening.
territory.text: Here, major sights fit naturally alongside simple pleasures. Walk to Cheverny, cycle towards Chambord and enjoy the village shops just a few minutes away.
territory.smallImageAlt: Dining room at La Maison Vigneronne
territory.title: Explore, discover, then come home slowly.

routes.title: A different escape every day.
routes.introduction: Three ways to set off from the house while staying close to what matters.

items.title: The Loire castles
items.text: Cheverny on foot, Chambord by bike, Blois and quieter historic estates.

items.title: Within 30 kilometres
items.text: Vineyards, villages, gardens, heritage and local food for every kind of day.
